pages.title: Orchard and Trellis
pages.text: $(bold)Hearth and Harvest's crops and farm tools: grapes on trellises, raspberries, blueberries, cherries, peanuts, corn, cotton and hops, the watering can, sprinkler, scarecrow, seed pouch, fertiliser and manure.$(br2)$(thing)Iron Age$(n), ring 3.$(br)$(thing)5 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Gardener.
